rationale.conceptual: Non-trivial method: the agent must correctly implement grain boundary geometries, indentation protocol, stress-force conversion using virial stress, all within the AIREBO potential framework. While not a novel algorithm, it requires careful application of established MD techniques.
rationale.execution: Multi-stage pipeline: build atomic structures, equilibrate (NPT+NVT), then run multiple indentation simulations (pristine, grain boundaries, offset tests) with different parameters, parse LAMMPS output, compute strengths. About 5-6 distinct simulation runs, each requiring correct input scripts. Not trivial but manageable for an experienced user.

difficulty.reasoning: The task requires setting up standard MD simulations using LAMMPS and AIREBO potential, constructing atomic models of pristine and bicrystalline graphene, and extracting failure strengths. No novel algorithms; the method is well-documented. Execution involves multiple steps (model building, equilibration, several indentation runs) but no complex data handling or fragile toolchains.

compute_estimate.reasoning: Graphene sheets of ~50 nm contain tens of thousands of atoms; MD runs of a few hundred picoseconds fit easily on a single CPU core with modest RAM; no external datasets required.
